title: Shipping-Fee Credit for Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders Customers Buying Tailwise Plus Annual
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus — shipping-fee credit.** When a customer on a free tier buys Tailwise Plus Annual, a shipping-fee credit — a flat dollar amount — is subtracted from the first-term Plus Annual fee according to the Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders on which the customer was charged a ship-to-home shipping fee, dated in the last 12 months.

| Orders charged a ship-to-home shipping fee in the last 12 months | Shipping-fee credit |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | $3.00 |
| 1 or 2 | $1.50 |
| none | none |

**Where the count comes from.** The shipping-fee charge entries on the customer's Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders history, counted by order, dated in the last 12 months.

**Edges (hypothetical).** No such order: none. One order: $1.50. Two orders: $1.50. Three orders: $3.00.
